title: player Revive plugin
description: Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Revival Totems.
body:
**Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Totems**

Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Revival Totems.
A plugin that allows players to revive dead teammates through a ritual system.
When a player dies, they drop a Revival Gem. Other players can use this gem to craft a Revival Totem by surrounding it with 8 Totems of Undying in a crafting table.
Place the crafted Revival Totem on an Item Frame inside the Revival Hall to start the revival ritual, which brings the dead player back to life.

**Features**
- Death Drops Revival Tag – When a player dies, a unique Revival Gem representing that player
  is dropped.
- Player Revival System – Use a PlayerRevival Gem + Totems of Undying to revive the dead
  player.
- Universal Revival Totem can revive any currently online dead player if the original
  gem/totem is lost
- Perfect for Hardcore / SMP Servers
- Custom crafting recipes
- Lightweight & optimized
- Encourages teamwork and risk management

**Download** the custom a resource pack featuring:
- Custom Revival Totem texture
- Hardcore-style hearts for revived players
  
Resourcepack : [Totem Resourcepack Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1br5DonLMsDHdi1_xYusb7abPp6NOrqTo/view?usp=sharing)

**Commands:**
- /newbornprot set <player> <minutes> – Set protection time for a player
- /newbornprot setall <minutes> – Set protection time for all players
- /newbornprot toggle – Show/Hide the protection timer bossbar
- /giveuniversalrevivaltotem <player> - Give Universal Revival Totem to anyone
- /deadplayerlist - Open dead players list
- /revivalhall - Teleport to Revival hall(Revival Ritual Hall)
- /return - Teleport back to overworld home from Revival hall
- /hr - Plugin Reload

**Permissions:**
- hardcorerevival.givetotem
- hardcorerevival.newbornprot.toggle
- hardcorerevival.newbornprot.add

**Use Cases**
- Hardcore SMP servers
- Story-based Minecraft servers
- Team survival gameplay
- Challenge-based worlds

## IMPORTANT
This plugin requires two structure maps to function properly.
Download the maps and place them in your server with the following names:

Revival Hall → folder name: revival_hall

Prison → folder name: prison

These structures are used for:

Revival Hall – Where players place the Revival Totem to start the revival ritual

Prison – Where dead players wait until they are revived

Make sure the folders are named exactly as shown above for the plugin to detect them correctly.
Download World File : [Prison and Revival hall World Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DObMMlaQXKItZa4Jbik-3mfeqodzfCZp/view?usp=sharing)
